question: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive, and what evidence supports each opportunity?
answer: The Vault contains no automotive opportunity assessment, market sizing, or pipeline record for the Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer line, so only indirect, evidence-backed hypotheses can be stated. The strongest is automotive satellite/NTN connectivity testing: the 3GPP NTN signal generator overview explicitly names automotive as one of the industries showing interest in 5G NTN-NR, and on the same slide credits R&S SMW200A channel emulation (long path delays, enhanced Doppler, customized dynamic fading) for NTN testing — and the Vault's NTN concept page already defines a ready SMW200A + FSW component-testing pair (SMW200A to 67/72 GHz with up to 2–4 GHz modulation bandwidth; FSW to 85/90 GHz with up to 8 GHz analysis bandwidth). Second, automotive radar echo generation is an attachable signal-generator capability: the SMW200A configuration guide lists R&S SMW-K78 'Radar echo generation' as an orderable Fading/MIMO option. Third, the Vault's deepest automotive T&M asset is the AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator with 76–81 GHz frontends, QAT100 antenna array and AREG-P1/P2/P3 production configurations — a documented path into automotive radar production test — but the Vault explicitly states this product is NOT an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer, so it is an adjacent/attach play rather than a SigGen/SA opportunity. Fourth, R&S already has automotive market access through NG eCall (CMX500 + CMX-KA098, EN 17240:2024, Qualcomm Snapdragon Auto verification, obligation starting 2026-01-01) and a Vice President Market Segment Automotive, which is a channel into automotive accounts even though the instrument of record is a radio communication tester. A longer-term pipeline item is 6G NTN, where the Vault lists automotive V2X safety applications among the use cases. No Vault evidence quantifies any of these opportunities.
missing: The Vault has no automotive market sizing, TAM/SAM, customer account, win/loss, pipeline or quotation evidence for the Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer line; no automotive application notes or solution-mapping pages (unlike the UAV / satellite / AI-server 'R&S solution mapping' concepts) for automotive radar, V2X/C-V2X, automotive Ethernet, EMC or in-vehicle connectivity; the SigGen/SA datasheet pages (SMW200A, SMM100A, SMCV100B, SMBV100B, SMB100B, SMA100B, FSV3000/FSVA3000/FPL/FSPN) contain no automotive application framing at all; and no pricing, competitive positioning (e.g. vs Keysight/Anritsu) or opportunity-ranking data exists for automotive.

key_points.point: Automotive is explicitly named as an industry showing interest in 5G NTN-NR, on the same slide that credits SMW200A channel emulation (long path delays, Doppler, customized dynamic fading) for NTN testing — the clearest SigGen link to automotive demand.
key_points.source: wiki/sources/3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.md
key_points.quote: gaining interest from chipset / device manufacturers、automotive、satellite / space industry

key_points.point: The Vault already defines a reusable signal generator + signal analyzer component-test pairing (SMW200A + FSW) for NTN, which is the configuration an automotive NTN module/chipset opportunity would use.
key_points.quote: component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]

key_points.point: The analyzer side of that pair is specified to 85 GHz (overrange 90 GHz) with up to 8 GHz analysis bandwidth, i.e. sufficient reach for mmWave/automotive-radar-band analysis work.
key_points.quote: [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。

key_points.point: Radar echo generation is an orderable SMW200A software option (SMW-K78), making radar echo generation an attach opportunity for the signal generator line itself.

The AREG800A offers automotive radar production configurations (AREG-P1/P2/P3 with digital channels, 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, MFP/BFP frontends), indicating an automotive radar production-test opportunity.
key_points.quote: [[R&S AREG-P1]] radar mini configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] base unit option：one digital channel，one object per channel，5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth

key_points.point: Critical scoping caveat: the Vault explicitly classifies the AREG800A automotive radar echo generator as outside the RF signal generator / spectrum analyzer category, so it must not be counted as a SigGen/SA opportunity.
key_points.quote: 但用途為 automotive radar echo generation，不屬 RF signal generator 或 spectrum analyzer。

key_points.point: R&S's documented automotive demand driver is NG eCall regulation (obligatory from 2026-01-01), but the instrument of record there is the CMX500 mobile radio tester, not a signal generator or analyzer.
key_points.quote: 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。

key_points.point: 6G NTN is a forward-looking automotive pipeline item: the Vault lists automotive V2X safety applications among 6G NTN use cases, a future driver for channel-emulation-capable generators and analyzers.
